description: Department of Inland Revenue - Amendments to Simplified Value Added Tax Scheme as the guidelines already issued under cicular No. SEC 2012/3 of 30.07.2012
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with regulatory matters under the Value Added Tax Act. It contains a notification by the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue prescribing guidelines for the Simplified Value Added Tax (SVAT) Scheme, including eligibility criteria, registration procedures, and operational details. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements related to taxation legislation.
